title: Add JSON output for podman system hyperv-prep --status
body:
Add --format=json support to podman system hyperv-prep --status.

The JSON output exposes the existing status information:
- isGroupMember: whether the current user is a member of the Hyper-V Administrators group
- hasRegistryEntries: whether the required vsock registry entries exist

Invalid --format values return an error, while the existing human-readable output remains unchanged when --format is not specified.

The existing --force/-f behavior is preserved.

Fixes #29860
